about.title: About Me
about.description: Frontend Developer with 5+ years of experience in building modern web applications using Vue/Nuxt, GraphQL, and Node.js. Skilled in designing and implementing complex logic on the frontend, working both independently and in teams. Focused on performance, clean architecture, and user experience. Open to remote opportunities and passionate about continuous learning and growth.

freelance.description: Built landing pages, mini-CRMs, and lightweight admin panels. Full cycle from requirements to deployment (Nuxt + Node + GraphQL). Communicated directly with clients and delivered polished UI/UX.

secureon.description: Worked as part of a team building a custom CRM for an internet provider. Used Vue 3, Pinia, Ant Design Vue, Axios. Implemented key features, integrated APIs, and contributed to component architecture.

productCompany.description: Independently developed and maintained several web apps using Vue + Nuxt + Node.js + Hasura. Implemented GraphQL integration, user authentication, internationalization, and PWA features. Focused on app optimization and clean, maintainable code.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.description: A selection of my personal projects.

taskwave.title: TaskWave
taskwave.description: TaskWave is a simple and elegant Kanban-style task management app built with Vue 3 and Tailwind CSS. Designed as a modern PWA, it supports offline usage, drag-and-drop, modal editing, search, theming, and local storage persistence.

cryptoview.title: CryptoView
cryptoview.description: CryptoView is a modern, real-time cryptocurrency tracker built with Nuxt 3. It features live updates from Binance, internationalization, currency selection, dark/light theme, and a mobile-first responsive design.

mediumclone.title: MediumClone
mediumclone.description: A single-page blog application that replicates core Medium.com features. Built using Vue 2, Vuex for state management, Vue Router for navigation, and Axios for API communication. Includes authentication, article creation/editing, and feed management.
